svg.title: Building Scale6 records in traversal order
svg.desc: An undirected fixture is traversed as PageRank pull. Its source adjacency 4 to 7 maps to internal row 8 and property vertex 18. Flattening the rows locates edge positions 18 and 22 as successive accesses to the same property line. Their distance four becomes token four, packed with vertex 18 as 0x10000012. The production directed builder uses two line-indexed arrays.
svg.text: Building Scale6 records in traversal order
One checked graph connects adjacency order, property-line reuse, and the packed record.
fixture weights are omitted; PageRank reads topology
Sparse internal IDs preserve the existing checked fixture; Scale6 is forced to 26 ID bits.
same property line, even when the vertex changes
production builder: directed graphs with distinct in/out CSR
Twitter: 41,652,230 vertices, 1,468,364,884 directed edges; about 39.7 MiB auxiliary state.
Construction finishes before the measured traversal. Preprocessing cost is reported separately.
